Teen Patti Rules and Hand Rankings

Teen Patti (three cards) is a quick South Asian card game. This page covers the rules and hand rankings only.

Keeping track of points? Use the Teen Patti points tracker.

The basics

Teen Patti is played by 3 to 6 players (sometimes more) with one 52-card deck and no printed jokers. Each player gets three cards face down. Aces are high, except in the A-2-3 sequence.

Hand rankings (highest to lowest)

#HandWhat it isExample
1Trail (trio, set)Three cards of the same rankA♠ A♥ A♦
2Pure sequence (straight flush)Three cards in a row, same suitQ♥ K♥ A♥
3Sequence (run)Three cards in a row, mixed suits4♣ 5♦ 6♠
4Color (flush)Three cards of the same suit, not in a row2♦ 8♦ J♦
5PairTwo cards of the same rank10♠ 10♣ 7♥
6High cardNone of the aboveK♠ 9♦ 4♣

Breaking ties

  • Trail: higher rank wins — A-A-A is the best hand, 2-2-2 the lowest trail.
  • Sequences: A-K-Q is the highest, then A-2-3 (in most rules), then K-Q-J, down to 4-3-2.
  • Color and high card: compare the highest card, then the second, then the third.
  • Pair: the higher pair wins; if pairs are equal, the higher odd card wins.
  • If two hands are exactly equal, the pot is usually split (some groups give it to the player who did not ask for the show).

How a round is played

  1. Everyone puts a fixed starting amount (the boot) into the pot, then three cards are dealt to each player.
  2. Players can play blind (without looking at their cards) or seen (after looking). A blind player's stake is half that of a seen player.
  3. Going round the table, each player either stays in by matching the current stake or folds (packs).
  4. A seen player can ask the previous seen player for a side show — a private comparison where the weaker hand must fold. The other player may refuse.
  5. When only two players remain, either can ask for a show: both reveal and the better hand wins the pot.

Popular variations

  • Muflis (lowball): rankings are reversed — the lowest hand wins.
  • AK47: all aces, kings, fours and sevens are jokers (wild cards).
  • Joker: one card is turned up after the deal; all cards of that rank are wild.
  • Lowest joker: the lowest card in each player's hand is wild for that player.
  • Four-card (best of four): each player gets four cards and plays the best three.

Frequently asked questions

What is the highest hand in Teen Patti?

A trail (three of a kind) is the highest hand, and three aces is the best trail. Next comes a pure sequence, then a sequence, color, pair and high card.

Is A-2-3 higher than K-Q-J in Teen Patti?

In most rules, yes. A-K-Q is the highest sequence, A-2-3 is second, and K-Q-J is third.

Which is higher in Teen Patti, a sequence or a color?

A sequence (three cards in a row) beats a color (three cards of the same suit that are not in a row).

What is Muflis in Teen Patti?

Muflis is a variation where the hand rankings are reversed, so the lowest hand wins.

What happens when two Teen Patti hands are equal?

If two hands are identical in rank, the pot is usually split between them.
